title: ImmutableContextReplicationNamespacePolicy
ownerNote: The Cross-Agent repository owns the Context Ledger, so the policy that governs its replication lives here. It is DATA that the adapter reads and enforces, not documentation: a rule written only in a comment is a rule that stops existing the moment someone edits the code around it.

authority.grant: The validated Immutable Context replication worker may write ONLY encrypted, content-addressed Immutable Context objects and required safe metadata, into DEDICATED Immutable Context namespaces on the two destinations below, through the validated replication adapter.
authority.generalRuleUnchanged: Direct L: and Z: writes remain prohibited for every other purpose. This is a narrow exception to that rule, not a relaxation of it.
authority.reproducibilityNote: This file is the authority. A future session reads it and gets the same enforcement without anyone re-stating the grant, which is the difference between an authorisation and a memory.

namespaceAllowlistOnly.description: Every written path MUST live under the destination's declared objectPrefix. Both shares are live business shares; the adapter must be incapable of touching anything that already exists on them.

contentAddressedOnly.description: The path MUST be exactly objectPrefix + objects/sha256/{aa}/{hash} for the hash being written, AND sha256(bytes) MUST equal that hash. A write whose path does not derive from its own content is not a content-addressed store, and it is the shape that lets one object silently overwrite another. objectStorePath already contributes the objects/sha256/{aa}/ segments, so objectPrefix is the NAMESPACE root only; doubling it produced capital-glass-immutable-context/objects/objects/.

encryptedOnly.description: Only ciphertext may leave this machine. Enforced mechanically rather than by trust: an AES-GCM blob is indistinguishable from random, so an object whose leading bytes are overwhelmingly printable UTF-8 is plaintext no matter what the caller claims, and is refused.

minimumEnvelopeBytes.description: 12-byte nonce plus 16-byte GCM tag. Anything shorter cannot be a valid envelope.

maxPrintableRatio.description: Printable-byte ratio over the leading sample above which an object is treated as plaintext and refused.

credentialBearingForbidden.description: A source that tripped the pre-admission detector never reaches replication at all: it has no content hash, no spool object and no ledger entry, so there is nothing for this adapter to be handed.

forbidden: manual shell copying to L: or Z:
arbitrary agent writes to L: or Z:
writes outside the dedicated Immutable Context namespace

refusalCodes.REPLICATION_DESTINATION_NOT_IN_POLICY: The mountpoint is not one of the two authorised destinations.
refusalCodes.REPLICATION_MOUNT_IDENTITY_MISMATCH: The live mount does not present the backing source this policy expects for that destination.
refusalCodes.REPLICATION_PATH_OUTSIDE_DEDICATED_NAMES: The target path is not under the destination's declared objectPrefix.
refusalCodes.REPLICATION_PATH_NOT_CONTENT_ADDRESSED: The target path is not the content address of the bytes being written.
refusalCodes.REPLICATION_PAYLOAD_HASH_MISMATCH: sha256(bytes) does not equal the address being written.
refusalCodes.REPLICATION_PAYLOAD_TOO_SHORT_FOR_ENVELO: Fewer bytes than a nonce plus a GCM tag.
refusalCodes.REPLICATION_PAYLOAD_LOOKS_LIKE_PLAINTEXT: The object decodes as predominantly printable text, so it is not ciphertext.
